inference.document_extraction__DocumentE.description:
The documents to extract the content from for the `document_extraction` task.
Either a `content` object or an array of `content` objects.

content.description: The document to extract the content from.

inference.document_extraction__DocumentE.description: A wrapper object which contains a single document to extract the content from.

type.description: The type of the document. Not all services and models support all types.

format.description:
The format of the document. If not specified, this defaults to `base64` for `pdf` and `image`, and `url` for `html`.
The `html` type supports `url` only.
Not all services and models support all formats.

value.description:
The value of the document. For the `base64` format, this must be a base64-encoded data URI, that is, "data:content/type;base64,...".
For the `url` format, this must be a URL that points to the document, that is, "https://example.com/document.pdf".

inference.document_extraction__DocumentE.description: An object describing a single document to extract the content from.

output_format.description: The output format of the extracted content. Only `markdown` is supported.

parameters.description:
A free-form object of extraction options that is forwarded to the Elastic Inference Service as-is.
The accepted parameters are defined by the Elastic Inference Service.

inference.document_extraction__DocumentE.description:
Task settings for the `document_extraction` task type of the `elastic` service.
They can be set when creating the inference endpoint and overridden per request.
Request values take precedence, and `parameters` are merged per key.
